C0054.title: Cloud Pay Sentenced for Pyramid Scheme via Agent and Infinite Fission Model
C0054.summary: Cloud Pay, a cardless payment platform, rapidly expanded by recruiting downlines through an agent and infinite fission model, promoting no investment and high returns. In 2017, the model went viral on social media, but after the case was exposed, the platform was shut down, and the founder and multiple agents were sentenced and fined.
